# Board Gaming Hub

> Free, single-file browser games and engineering simulations. 32 titles, no installs, no accounts, no signup. The simulations implement real published methods — NRCS TR-55 hydrology, total-dissolved-gas dam operations, Tsiolkovsky and patched-conic orbital mechanics, sub-arcsecond eclipse ephemeris — and each documents its model on the page.

Every title is one self-contained HTML file with no server-side dependency: open the page and play, offline included. The site is built and maintained by Michael Flynn, PE, a dam-safety and stormwater engineer, which is why the simulations use the same methods as professional practice rather than arcade approximations. Source for the whole collection is public at https://github.com/mf4633/board-gaming (MIT).

## Engineering & science simulations

These are the site's distinctive titles. Each states its governing equations and assumptions in an on-page "How the model works" section.

- [Apoapsis](https://boardgaminghub.com/apoapsis): 3D rocket and spaceflight simulator in the browser. Tsiolkovsky rocket equation, vis-viva for orbital velocity, patched-conic sphere-of-influence transitions with encounter and escape prediction, barometric atmosphere, per-stage delta-v and TWR readouts, Hohmann transfer planning, maneuver nodes with prograde/normal/radial components, seven SAS hold modes, hyperbolic flyby arcs, reentry heating, specific-impulse-driven staging, and Mun landings. Answers "free browser KSP alternative", "online orbital mechanics simulator", "learn delta-v and patched conics interactively".
- [Floodline](https://boardgaminghub.com/floodline): Flood-defense simulation over six historical California scenarios. SCS Type II rainfall distribution (NRCS TR-55), SCS triangular unit hydrograph for upstream routing, shallow-water cellular automaton with 8-neighbor gradient flux, Green-Ampt-like infiltration with antecedent moisture, stage-discharge rating curve at the tailwater boundary, levee overtopping and piping-failure stress model, and HAZUS-MH-style stage-damage curves for building loss. Answers "flood routing simulator", "how levees fail", "what is a unit hydrograph", "interactive TR-55".
- [Bonneville Spillway Operator](https://boardgaminghub.com/bonnevillespillwayoperator): Columbia River dam-operations simulator at River Mile 146. Balance grid megawatt demand against spill in kcfs, turbine dispatch, forebay and tailwater head, total dissolved gas (TDG) limits, salmon smolt passage and fish ladders, navigation lockages, and wind generation on the grid. Includes a sandbox mode for building your own dam. Answers "how does a hydroelectric dam operate", "what is total dissolved gas", "why do dams spill water", "salmon vs power tradeoff".
- [Eclipse Predictor](https://boardgaminghub.com/eclipsepredictor): 3D solar eclipse path map for every eclipse from 1900 to 2200, using the astronomy-engine ephemeris at sub-arcsecond accuracy. Delta-T corrected terrestrial time, equator-of-date sun and moon positions with aberration, and rendered paths of totality on a globe. Covers the 12 August 2026 total eclipse (Spain, Iceland) and the 2 August 2027 eclipse (Spain to Egypt, 6+ minutes of totality). Answers "2026 eclipse path map", "2027 eclipse where to watch", "eclipse predictor tool".
- [Biosphere Blue](https://boardgaminghub.com/biosphereblue): Planet-scale geosim in the SimEarth lineage. Tune temperature, ocean fraction, and atmospheric composition; watch life evolve from microbes through a civilization technology arc, with heat, biome, and atmosphere view overlays.
- [Metropolis 2K](https://boardgaminghub.com/metropolis2k): City-building simulation with a documented model — a monthly tick loop, residential/commercial/industrial demand, an explicit tax formula, and a municipal bond model. Drive and fly camera modes, scenarios, and achievements.
- [Tower / SKYSTACK](https://boardgaminghub.com/tower): SimTower-style high-rise operations sim. Elevator scheduling, tenant satisfaction, fires and emergencies, financing, scenarios, and a daily challenge. Extended version sold on Steam.
- [Doctrine](https://boardgaminghub.com/doctrine): Aerobiz-style geopolitical strategy spanning 1990–2050 on a real d3-geo world map, with a documented annual turn cycle and economy model covering alliances, influence projection, and trade.
- [Cliffwalkers](https://boardgaminghub.com/cliffwalkers): Lemmings-style puzzle platformer — assign skills, dig tunnels, build bridges, climb cliffs across a level ladder. Also on Google Play.

## Original board & strategy games

- [Bisque](https://boardgaminghub.com/bisque): Risk-style naval area control over Peconic Bay — deploy, attack, multi-fortify; last captain standing wins. Balance validated over 100 simulated games.
- [Tidelands](https://boardgaminghub.com/tidelands): Bronze-age maritime trade on a hex board where the tide floods islands on a cycle — harvest, build camps, temples and triremes, race to 15 VP.
- [Aresia](https://boardgaminghub.com/aresia): Mars colonization in the Catan lineage, 1–6 players with per-seat human/AI toggle — habitats, domes, pipelines, mission cards, dust storms, longest pipeline and largest fleet bonuses.
- [Convergence](https://boardgaminghub.com/convergence): Rival civilizations on a shared economy with a swinging market — settlements, cities, roads and markets to 12 VP.
- [Agora](https://boardgaminghub.com/agora): Mediterranean trade — roll for resources, trade at the central Agora, race to 30 coins.
- [Odyssey](https://boardgaminghub.com/odyssey): Greek island trading and tides, upon the wine-dark sea.
- [Wordform](https://boardgaminghub.com/wordform): Daily five-letter word puzzle, one word per day, shareable results without spoilers.
- [Drift](https://boardgaminghub.com/drift): Daily word ladder — change one letter per step to reach the target word.

## Classic and ancient games

Faithful free implementations, each with rules and strategy notes on the page:

- [Chess](https://boardgaminghub.com/chess) — vs AI or two-player, full move validation
- [Go](https://boardgaminghub.com/go) — 19×19 territory and influence (baduk / weiqi)
- [Backgammon](https://boardgaminghub.com/backgammon) — classic dice race
- [Othello](https://boardgaminghub.com/othello) — reversi rules and flipping strategy
- [Mancala](https://boardgaminghub.com/mancala) — standard Kalah count-and-capture
- [Senet](https://boardgaminghub.com/senet) — reconstruction of the 5,000-year-old Egyptian racing game with throwsticks
- [Royal Game of Ur](https://boardgaminghub.com/ur) — the 4,500-year-old Mesopotamian race game
- [Pente Grammai](https://boardgaminghub.com/pentegrammai) — ancient Greek game of five lines
- [Mahjong](https://boardgaminghub.com/mahjong) — solitaire tile matching

## Puzzles and solo games

- [Sudoku](https://boardgaminghub.com/sudoku) — easy through expert, daily puzzle
- [Solitaire](https://boardgaminghub.com/solitaire) — Klondike
- [Minesweeper](https://boardgaminghub.com/minesweeper)
- [2048](https://boardgaminghub.com/2048) — slide and merge tiles
- [Abacus](https://boardgaminghub.com/abacus) — playable soroban with calculator pad, Arabic and Roman display
- [LovedWords](https://boardgaminghub.com/lovedwords/) — first-words flashcards for toddlers using your own photos and voice

## Guides

17 strategy and science articles at [/guides/](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/), including those written to explain the simulation models rather than game tactics:

- [Floodline Scenarios Explained](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/floodline-scenarios) — the hydrology behind each historical California flood scenario
- [Bonneville Dam Operator Guide](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/bonneville-dam-guide) — spill, TDG, fish passage and grid balancing explained
- [2026 & 2027 Solar Eclipse Guide](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/eclipse-2026) — paths, timing and viewing sites
- Game strategy: [chess](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/free-browser-chess), [Go](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/go-rules-beginners), [backgammon](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/backgammon-rules), [Othello](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/othello-reversi), [Klondike solitaire](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/solitaire-klondike), [sudoku](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/sudoku-tips), [2048](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/2048-strategy), [Minesweeper](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/minesweeper-strategy), [Mahjong solitaire](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/mahjong-solitaire), [Wordform](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/wordform-tips), [Drift](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/drift-word-ladder)
- History and rules: [Senet](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/senet-rules), [Royal Game of Ur](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/royal-game-of-ur), [Pente Grammai](https://boardgaminghub.com/guides/pente-grammai)

## Audience

People looking for free no-install browser games; students and educators who want an interactive way into orbital mechanics, hydrology, dam operations, or eclipse geometry; engineers curious how a practitioner models these systems; and board-game hobbyists exploring original designs and ancient games.

## Pricing

Free. No accounts, no subscriptions, no in-game purchases, no ads on gameplay pages. Extended native versions of some simulations are sold on itch.io and Steam; the browser versions remain free and complete.
